record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: For a vertex operator algebra V and an infinite group G of automorphisms of V, under what conditions do twisted logarithmic intertwining operators among the g-twisted V-modules for all g in G satisfy associativity, commutativity, and modular invariance? Under what conditions is the category of all such g-twisted V-modules a G-crossed tensor category?

evidence.quote: Problem 6.4. Let V be a vertex operator algebra and let G be a group of automorphisms of V. If G is an infinite group, under what conditions do the twisted logarithmic intertwining operators among the g-twisted V-modules for all g in G satisfy the associativity, commutativity and modular invariance properties? Under what conditions is the category of g-twisted V-modules for all g in G a G-crossed (tensor) category?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V$ be a vertex operator algebra and let $G$ be an infinite group of automorphisms of $V$. For each $g\in G$, let $\mathcal{C}_g$ denote the category of (generalized) $g$-twisted $V$-modules, and consider the twisted logarithmic intertwining operators of types $\binom{W_3}{W_1\,W_2}$ where $W_i$ is $g_i$-twisted ($i=1,2,3$) and the operators may involve formal logarithms of the variable.

(a) Identify natural conditions on $V$ and on $G$ (e.g., finiteness/cofiniteness assumptions on $V$, growth/structural assumptions on $G$ and its action, suitable convergence and grading-restriction hypotheses on the modules) under which:
 (i) products and iterates of such twisted logarithmic intertwining operators converge on appropriate domains and satisfy the associativity property (equality of products and iterates after analytic continuation);
 (ii) they satisfy the commutativity property in the $G$-crossed sense (with the $G$-action conjugating the twist);
 (iii) the formal characters / pseudotrace functions of the $g$-twisted modules transform appropriately under the modular group, giving a modular-invariance statement extending the finite-orbifold case.

(b) Under those same conditions, determine when the disjoint union (or suitable direct-limit) category $\bigoplus_{g\in G}\mathcal{C}_g$ carries the structure of a $G$-crossed (braided) tensor category, with tensor product bifunctors, associativity and unit constraints, $G$-grading respected by tensor product, a $G$-action by tensor functors, and $G$-crossed braiding isomorphisms.

Provide such conditions and prove that they imply (i)–(iii) and the $G$-crossed tensor category structure.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2024–2025) develops twisted intertwining operators, tensor products of generalized twisted modules, and cofiniteness/P(z)-tensor-product bifunctors for orbifold theories associated with abelian but not-necessarily-finite groups, constructing G-crossed commutativity/braiding isomorphisms in special cases. However, the general problem for arbitrary infinite groups G — establishing associativity, commutativity, modular invariance of twisted logarithmic intertwining operators and the full G-crossed tensor category structure — remains open, with only partial results in the abelian/cofinite setting.

status_evidence.title: Cofiniteness and P(z)-tensor product bifunctors in orbifold theories associated to abelian but not-necessarily-finite groups
status_evidence.snippet: Orbifold theories associated to abelian but not-necessarily-finite groups; constructs P(z)-tensor product bifunctors and discusses G-crossed structure.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress exists for abelian infinite groups, not the general case.

status_evidence.title: Twisted intertwining operators and tensor products of (generalized) twisted modules
status_evidence.snippet: Develops twisted intertwining operators and tensor products of generalized twisted modules.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational machinery being developed; general infinite-G case not settled.

status_evidence.title: Cofiniteness for Twisted Fusion Products in Vertex Operator Algebra Theory
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial results on conditions ensuring tensor structure for twisted modules.
